high: ARTIFACT_CHAIN_INCONSISTENT: all eleven current files exist, but the current chain contradicts itself about the revised variety model and retains superseded simulation/fact-sheet claims. Most importantly, reference_research_v3 describes つぶたね as heat-tolerant and directly grounded in 愛紅, while the adopted translation and simulator require it to be heat-vulnerable. play_seeds_v2 still reports the obsolete 60.7% reasoning result and 39.3% unwinnable-session rate; core_back_check_v2 cites design-sim v3 instead of the current v4; scope/core checks still cite fact_sheet_v2. The current design therefore lacks one internally consistent, implementable source of truth.
medium: REACTION_DOES_NOT_TEACH_NEXT_ACTION remains: an incorrect choice produces only an undifferentiated failure and immediately ends the session. The child receives no diagnostic clue, in-session reconsideration, or subsequent judgment in which to apply what was learned.

The player-facing fictional-data disclaimer closes the direct misinformation defect, but placing the same small disclaimer at the bottom of every card is visually inefficient and may compete with decision-critical data on a 375px layout. Consolidate it into one clearly readable note associated with the card set.
low: The design-sim note names a nonexistent/outdated field, no_variety_dominates_any_month, while the actual output field is no_variety_dominates_any_multi_candidate_month.
first_5_seconds_v1 does not mention the newly mandatory player-facing learning-setting disclosure, despite game_translations_v4 defining it as part of the first visible state.

failure_codes.finding: Current artifacts disagree about つぶたね's heat tolerance and retain obsolete numerical results and upstream references, so an implementer cannot faithfully derive one authoritative design from the current chain.
Flat failure followed by session termination supplies no actionable information or first-play opportunity to reconsider the deadline, sowing window, or forecast.
